description: Our team is looking for motivated creative and good data analysists
summary: Our project is a storytelling video explaining how "abandonned" hardware in space isnt just trash sitting there waiting to be frogotten but humanity's fingerprint and solid living proof that we decided to discover what was beyond without thinking much about what could possibly go wrong. We believe it is important because it helps young and old people understand the importance of humanity's achievements and it's "leftovers" beyond the horizon.
details: Basically, our project is a storytelling video about abondonned hardaware in space. In our opinion, this video would be very helpful for every age range especially very young or older poeple leaning towards space discovery. From this project, we want poeple from all around the world to know the truth about humans space travels and to understand how much of an important achievement it is. To develop this project, we used canva to write our story and work on the project guide, while we used capcut to edit the final video and latex to prepare the ressources page, and finally used Claude AI and Gemini AI to gather more intresting information and help with the writing and editing of the final project. Our project is creative by being direct and very easy to understand, we tried to consider every person's position infront of our final video and tried to clarify it as much as possible for it to be very understandable even with low quality fiming or low audio quality. (We're a group of teenagers we rarely have access to the most importat tools unfortunately)
projectRefs: The Actual Story (Three dots in the dust)
